mesoscaleDiscussions.summary: Strong to locally severe gusts are possible overnight

details.label: Summary
details.text: Strong to locally severe gusts are possible overnight

details.label: Discussion
details.text: An MCS is moving across north-central KS towards south-central NE early this morning. Relatively strong inbound velocities (45-55 kt) are noted at 1-2 km AGL from KUEX along the gust front, though recent measured gusts have generally been sub-severe. Low-level warm advection and a plume of large PW (near/above 2 inches) to the north of a front draped across southern KS may help to sustain this system through at least part of the overnight, though rather weak mid/upper-level flow, modest effective shear, and unfavorable low-level lapse rates may tend to keep any severe-gust threat localized. Additional storms may continue to develop in advance of the MCS across northeast KS into northwest MO, within the warm-advection regime north of the front. The large PW will support localized downburst potential within this regime as well, though the elevated nature of the convection and generally modest effective shear are expected to limit the coverage and magnitude of the threat
